profile.headline: Software Engineer | Deep Learning | Machine Learning
profile.summary: Juan is a Software Engineer that focuses on solving Machine Learning problems at scale. He has worked on machine learning for healthcare, perception, robotics, and recently, for software testing. At Uber, Juan teaches Intro to Deep Learning and Deep Learning for Computer Vision to ignite the creativity of others every quarter. Lastly, Juan and his team work on Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and other high-priority problems that deliver great business value to the company

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Invented a Python debug tool and flows for validation in high volume manufacturing (HVM) hardware, which had never been done before and increases productivity by 20x 
- Designed and implemented a cryptography pipeline to be integrated with IoT products.
- Mentored an intern on computer vision models for her Summer internship project involving drones and vision.
- Developed build & release tools and lead a team of 5 in their build and release efforts.
- Wrote a MapReduce API to provide ~ 30x runtime reduction for one of Intel’s internal tools.
- Interviewed and hired interns at recruiting events.

positions.title: Graduate Technical Intern
positions.description:
- Created Python bindings for 16 operating systems and architectures for the Intel TraceHub and proposed changes to the software stack to reduce runtime by 66% (See https://software.intel.com/en-us/intel-platform-analysis-library for more details)
- Developed the gesture recognition algorithms of a wearable device that can classify up to 12 gestures with over 80% of accuracy

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Designed a sensor-based application for Google Glass that determines how physically active the user is. Then, it provides positive feedback on the user’s physical activity levels to encourage the user to be more physically active.  
• Programmed a brainwave-controlled first person shooter game for desktops to train users to work efficiently while being anxious.
• Created an immersive head-mounted-display with a first person shooter application using off-the shelf electronics to study encumbrances in virtual reality and how they affect performance in virtual reality.
• Developed a computer vision and speech recognition program to evaluate the performance of teams in high-risk medical scenarios.

positions.title: Applications Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a dynamic reporting system for various projects hosted within Microsoft Project Server 2010.
• Developed and executed a JQuery reporting engine for Microsoft Sharepoint sites hosted within Microsoft Project Server 2010
• Improved the performance of SQL-driven reports by 70%.

educations.schoolName: Stanford University Graduate School of Business

honors.title: GEM Fellow
honors.description: Received a GEM fellowship sponsored by Intel Corporation
honors.issuer: Issued by The National GEM Consortium · Dec 2014

projects.title: Omega Vest
projects.description: My responsibilities (with Seng Loong Yu) include software development of the Omega Player, which is a Windows video player developed in C# with the .NET Framework that is used to compare time stamps in a video and a formatted CSV file to send serial string messages to a microcontroller via the USB interface. We also programmed the the microcontroller to read the string messages sent by the Windows application and to enable/disable certain pins for various electrical components (motors and servos).

publications.title: Classification of ADHD and Non-ADHD using theta/beta power ratio features
EEG channel selection for AR model based ADHD classification

organizations.name: Tau Beta Pi

• Obtained 1000$ from corporate and university sponsors to continue organizing workshops on soft skills.
• Tutored K-12 students in math sciences.
